'''2012 European Championship Kristian Snukke DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kristian Snukke]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Username:''' rax
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
